items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Well, he was in the band at the same time that Trummy Young was.

ctx.x: hearing him play. It was just fantastic. Of course the old school of piano, the full stride, Art Tatum type things, and in other words, the piano player in that school of piano, they had to sound like a whole band. They played their own accompaniment and the band and the solos and everything, but he was absolutely fabulous, but he would not leave Houston, Texas. And that's Turk Van Lake. I mean he would not leave New York.
